items.title: Elvin Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Dizzy asked me and he said, “Hey man, I’m forming another band. Would you be available?” and at that point I was. ... I just told Dizzy last night that I am going to play in his new group

ctx.x: Had you actually played a drum set at this point? Had you actually sat down at a drum set?

Well they had one there. I said, “I don’t want to get started on this because I don’t know anything about it!” (Laughs). So I had to study first. I first heard Dizzy Gillespie and the drummer was Big Sid Catlett and I don’t know who—it was a small group a quartet, a quintet, something like that. And they were playing “Salt Peanuts”. And Big Sid, Sid Catlett plays this introduction to “Salt Peanuts” on brushes—(Elvin imitates the whooshing and galloping sound of brushes). I said, “That’s the prettiest thing I’ve…
So you saw the band (Dizzy’s band) live?
